summary: Price oscillated near breakeven/mild-adverse for the first three frames (0, -5.75, -13.25 then a recovery to -3.00), which read like normal dip-and-recover noise so I held. Frame 4 broke that pattern: price pushed to a new adverse low of -19.00 (beyond the prior -13.25 trough) on a freshly-started leg with 0% giveback -- meaning the new leg was purely against the position with no counter-move -- plus 3 of 4 recent signal fires (KMDR, CLIMAX, PROPP) against and falling 5m volatility, so I bailed rather than waiting for the loss to compound. Next time I'd watch specifically for 'new leg entirely against, 0% giveback' as the tell that a dip has become a trend, versus a same-leg pullback that still has two-sided giveback texture.
